extensions.org.licoland.adapter.hermes/purpose: The Hermes Agent adapter: the persistent ACP frame dialect that classifies one Hermes stdio JSON-RPC line exactly once below the adapter port, the permission question Hermes asks, and the normalized transitions a Hermes turn reduces to. The kernel owns no part of Hermes' protocol and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.hermes/persistentDa: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The Hermes session records it reads belong to the installed Hermes client, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's.
